card.name: Time and tasks to be done
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that name time, tasks or effort to be spent, such as "time" after "what", "tasks" after "Many", and "do" in a "to do" list. Fires on the word just before a verb like monitor, need to be done, or start.

modes.label: Time and task nouns
modes.description: Nouns like time or tasks that lead into things to be done or watched for.
modes.example: Learn what<< time>> of year to monitor for those pests.

modes.label: To-do list and effort phrases
modes.description: Words inside phrases about doing work or spending effort, like a to do list or time and money.
